conflicts.fact: Column vectors for the Westlands and South B routes, and whether they have magnitude 8 km
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 gives the Westlands vector as (−5, 6), magnitude about 7.8 km. Lessons 5 and 6 use (−6; 5) for Westlands, with magnitude about 7.8 km, and (4; −6) for South B, with magnitude about 7.2 km. Lesson 6 says both drivers travel the same 8 km straight-line distance, yet it computes 7.8 and 7.2 km, so the two routes have unequal magnitudes. Lesson 1 and Lesson 8 both say the routes are exactly 8 km.
